verse: And when my way lies through a valley of gloom, I fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff comfort me.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm walking through a really dark time and I'm scared.", "I don't know how I'll get through this loss.", "I feel afraid and alone right now."]
verse_es: Aunque pase por el valle de sombra de muerte, no temeré peligro alguno, porque tú estás a mi lado. Tu vara y tu bastón me infunden aliento.

verse: Weeping may lodge for the night, but the morning brings shouts of joy.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't think this sadness will ever end.", "I cried myself to sleep again last night.", "Will things ever feel okay again?"]
verse_es: Porque su enojo dura solo un momento, pero su favor dura toda la vida. El llanto puede durar toda la noche, pero a la mañana llega la alegría.

verse: The Lord is near to the broken-hearted, he helps those whose spirit is crushed.
example_user_phrasings: ["My heart feels shattered.", "I feel completely crushed inside.", "I don't know how to keep going after this."]
verse_es: Yahvé está cerca de los que tienen el corazón quebrantado, y salva a los que tienen el espíritu abatido.

verse: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. So we have no fear, though earth should change, and the hills totter into the heart of the ocean.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm terrified with everything falling apart around me.", "I feel like the ground is shifting under me.", "I don't feel safe with everything that's happening."]
verse_es: Dios es nuestro refugio y nuestra fuerza, nuestra ayuda siempre presente en las angustias. Por eso no temeremos, aunque la tierra tiemble, y los montes se hundan en el fondo del mar;

verse: Cast your burden on the Lord, and he will sustain you. He will never let the righteous be shaken.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't know how to carry all of this anymore.", "Everything feels like too much right now.", "I can't stop worrying about everything."]
verse_es: Entrégale tus cargas a Yahvé, y él te cuidará. Él no permitirá jamás que los justos tropiecen y caigan.

verse: Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will bring its own anxieties. Every day has trouble enough of its own.
example_user_phrasings: ["I keep worrying about what's going to happen tomorrow.", "I can't stop thinking about the future.", "I'm anxious about everything that could go wrong."]
verse_es: Por lo tanto, no se preocupen por el día de mañana, porque el mañana traerá sus propias preocupaciones. Cada día tiene ya sus propios problemas.

verse: Come to me, all you who toil and are burdened, and I will give you rest! Take my yoke on you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest for your souls; for my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm so exhausted, I don't have anything left to give.", "I feel like I'm carrying too much on my own.", "I just need rest, I'm running on empty."]
verse_es: “Vengan a mí todos los que están cansados y llevan cargas pesadas, y yo les daré descanso. Pónganse mi yugo y aprendan de mí, que soy manso y humilde de corazón, y encontrarán descanso para sus almas. Porque mi yugo es fácil de llevar, y mi carga es liviana”.

verse: Peace be with you! My own peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled, or dismayed.
example_user_phrasings: ["My heart feels troubled and unsettled.", "I can't shake this fear.", "I don't feel at peace with anything right now."]
verse_es: La paz les dejo. Mi paz les doy; no se la doy como la da el mundo. No se turbe su corazón, ni tenga miedo.

verse: I have spoken to you in this way, so that in me you may find peace. In the world you will find trouble; yet, take courage! I have conquered the world.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel discouraged by everything going wrong.", "This world feels so hard to face right now.", "I need courage to keep going."]
verse_es: Les he dicho estas cosas para que en mí tengan paz. En el mundo tienen problemas; pero ¡anímense! Yo he vencido al mundo.

verse: We do know that God causes all things to work together for the good of those who love him – those who have received the call in accordance with his purpose.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't understand why this is happening to me.", "I can't see any good coming from this situation.", "I wonder if there's any purpose behind all this pain."]
verse_es: Sabemos que todas las cosas cooperan para el bien de los que aman a Dios, de los que son llamados según su propósito.

verse: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor archangels, nor the present, nor the future, nor any powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God revealed in Christ Jesus, our Lord!
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like God has abandoned me.", "I feel so alone and disconnected from everyone.", "I wonder if I'm too far gone for God to love me."]
verse_es: Porque estoy convencido de que ni la muerte, ni la vida, ni los ángeles, ni los principados, ni lo presente, ni lo futuro, ni las potencias, ni la altura, ni la profundidad, ni ninguna otra cosa creada podrá separarnos del amor de Dios que está en Cristo Jesús, nuestro Señor.

verse: Do not be anxious about anything; but under all circumstances, by prayer and entreaty joined with thanksgiving, make your needs known to God. Then the peace of God, which is beyond all human understanding, will stand guard over your hearts and thoughts, through your union with Christ Jesus.
example_user_phrasings: ["I can't stop worrying about everything in my life.", "My mind just won't quiet down.", "I need peace, I'm so anxious."]
verse_es: No se angustien por nada; más bien, en toda ocasión, con oración y ruego, presenten sus peticiones a Dios y denle gracias. Y la paz de Dios, que sobrepasa todo entendimiento, cuidará sus corazones y sus pensamientos en Cristo Jesús.

verse: My friends, whatever trials you may face from time to time, always regard them as a reason for rejoicing, knowing, as you do, that the testing of your faith develops endurance. And let endurance do its work perfectly, so that you may be altogether perfect, and in no respect lacking.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like I'm being tested and I don't know why.", "This trial is wearing me down.", "I don't know how much more I can take."]
verse_es: Hermanos míos, alégrense cuando caigan en diversas pruebas, sabiendo que la prueba de su fe produce paciencia. Dejen que la paciencia tenga su obra perfecta, para que sean perfectos y cabales, sin que les falte nada.

verse: Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God, so that he may exalt you in his good time, laying all your anxieties on him, for he makes you his care.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm carrying so much anxiety I can't function.", "I don't know how to let go of my worries.", "Everything feels out of my control."]
verse_es: Humíllense, pues, bajo la poderosa mano de Dios, para que él los exalte a su debido tiempo. Echen sobre él toda su ansiedad, porque él cuida de ustedes.

verse: My help is enough for you; for my strength attains its perfection in the midst of weakness.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel so weak and inadequate.", "I don't have the strength to keep going on my own.", "I feel like I'm not enough."]
verse_es: Pero él me ha dicho: “Te basta con mi gracia, pues mi poder se perfecciona en la debilidad”. Por lo tanto, me jactaré de mis debilidades con mucho gusto, para que el poder de Cristo descanse sobre mí.

verse: How long, Lord, will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me? How long must I nurse grief inside me, and in my heart a daily sorrow? How long are my foes to exult over me?
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like God has forgotten about me.", "How long is this going to last?", "I don't see this pain ending anytime soon."]
verse_es: ¿Hasta cuándo, Yahvé? ¿Me vas a olvidar para siempre? ¿Hasta cuándo me esconderás tu rostro? ¿Hasta cuándo tendré angustia en mi alma, y tristeza en mi corazón todos los días? ¿Hasta cuándo triunfará mi enemigo sobre mí?

verse: My God, my God, why have you left me, my rescue so far from the words of my roaring? I cry in the day, you do not answer, I cry in the night but find no rest.
example_user_phrasings: ["Why does it feel like God isn't listening to me?", "I feel so abandoned right now.", "I keep crying out but nothing changes."]
verse_es: Dios mío, Dios mío, ¿por qué me has abandonado? ¿Por qué estás tan lejos para salvarme, tan lejos de mis gritos de angustia? Dios mío, clamo de día, pero no me respondes; clamo de noche, y no encuentro descanso.

verse: I say to God my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why must I walk so sadly, so hard pressed by the foe?” It pierces me to the heart to hear the enemy’s taunts, as all the day long they say to me, “Where is your God?” Why am I downcast? Why this moaning within me? Hope in God; for yet will I praise him, my help, my God.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't understand why I feel so low.", "I keep asking myself why God feels so distant.", "I'm trying to hold onto hope but it's hard."]
verse_es: Le digo a Dios, mi roca: “¿Por qué me has olvidado? ¿Por qué debo andar de luto por la opresión del enemigo?” Como un golpe mortal a mis huesos, mis adversarios me insultan, preguntándome a todas horas: “¿Dónde está tu Dios?” ¿Por qué voy a inquietarme? ¿Por qué me voy a angustiar? ¡En Dios pondré mi esperanza! Porque todavía lo alabaré, ¡él es mi salvador y mi Dios!

verse: For the Lord I waited and waited, till, inclining to me, he heard my cry. From the horrible pit he drew me, up out of the miry clay; he set my feet on a rock, and my steps he made firm. He put a new song in my mouth, of praise to our God. Many see it, and, filled with awe, put their trust in the Lord.
example_user_phrasings: ["I finally feel like I'm coming out of a dark place.", "Things are starting to turn around for me.", "I want to thank God for pulling me through this."]
verse_es: Puse en Yahvé toda mi esperanza; él se inclinó hacia mí y escuchó mi clamor. Me sacó del pozo de la desesperación, del lodo y del fango; puso mis pies sobre una roca, y me dio un lugar firme donde apoyarme. Puso en mi boca un cántico nuevo, un himno de alabanza a nuestro Dios. Muchos verán esto y temerán, y pondrán su confianza en Yahvé.

verse: Turn to me with your favor, for I am lonely and crushed. In my heart are strain and storm; bring me out of my distresses. Look on my misery and trouble, and pardon all my sins.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel so alone and overwhelmed.", "Nobody understands what I'm going through.", "I feel crushed by everything happening."]
verse_es: Vuélvete a mí y ten compasión de mí, porque me siento solo y afligido. Las angustias de mi corazón han crecido; sácame de mis tormentos. Fíjate en mi dolor y en mis sufrimientos, y perdona todos mis pecados.

verse: They who sow in tears shall reap with glad shouts. Forth they fare, with their burden of seed, and they weep as they go. But home, home, with glad shouts they shall come with their arms full of sheaves.
example_user_phrasings: ["I've been putting in so much effort with nothing to show for it yet.", "I hope all this hard work and heartache will pay off.", "I'm holding onto hope that better days are coming."]
verse_es: Los que siembran con lágrimas cosecharán con gritos de alegría. El que sale llorando mientras lleva la semilla para sembrar, volverá cantando de alegría, trayendo sus manojos de trigo.

verse: Out of the depths I call to you, Lord. Lord, hear my voice: give heed with your ears to my loud plea.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like I'm in the depths of despair.", "I don't know how much lower I can go.", "I need God to hear me right now."]
verse_es: De lo profundo, oh Yahvé, a ti clamo. Señor, escucha mi voz; estén atentos tus oídos a la voz de mis súplicas.

verse: By the waters of Babylon there we sat, and we wept at the thought of Zion. There on the poplars we hung our harps. For there our captors called for a song: our tormentors, rejoicing, saying: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion.” How can we sing the Lord’s song in the foreigner’s land?
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel so out of place here, far from everything familiar.", "I don't know how to feel joy in this situation.", "Being away from home is breaking my heart."]
verse_es: Junto a los ríos de Babilonia nos sentábamos, y llorábamos al acordarnos de Sión. En los sauces de esa tierra colgamos nuestras arpas. Porque allí, los que nos llevaron cautivos nos pedían canciones; nuestros opresores nos exigían canciones de alegría, diciendo: “¡Cántennos alguna de las canciones de Sión!”. ¿Cómo podremos cantar las canciones de Yahvé en una tierra extranjera?

verse: How long, Lord, have I cried out and without you hearing me! I cry to you, “Violence!” but you do not help. Why do you make me look upon wickedness and behold trouble? Destruction and violence are before my eyes, and fighting and quarrelling. Therefore the law is weak, and justice is never rendered; for the wicked surround the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
example_user_phrasings: ["Why does God let injustice happen?", "I've been praying and nothing seems to change.", "I'm angry that things aren't fair."]
verse_es: Yahvé, ¿hasta cuándo voy a pedirte ayuda sin que me escuches? Te grito: “¡Violencia!”, pero tú no vienes a salvar. ¿Por qué me obligas a ver la maldad y te quedas mirando el sufrimiento? Veo ante mí destrucción y violencia; surge la lucha y se levanta el pleito. Por eso la ley ha perdido su fuerza y la justicia nunca se aplica; los malvados acosan a los justos, y por eso la justicia sale pervertida.

verse: I will repay you for the years which the swarming locust has eaten. The hopping, the destroying, and the cutting locusts, my great army which I sent among you, and my people will never again be put to shame.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like I've lost so many years to hard times.", "I wonder if I can ever get back what I've lost.", "I regret how much time was wasted."]
verse_es: Yo les devolveré lo que perdieron en los años que comió la langosta, el pulgón, el saltamontes y la oruga, ese gran ejército que envié contra ustedes.

verse: “Why say ‘possibly’?” Jesus replied. “Everything is possible for one who has faith.” The boy’s father immediately cried out, “I have faith; help my want of faith!”
example_user_phrasings: ["I want to believe but I'm struggling with doubt.", "I don't have enough faith right now.", "I feel helpless watching someone I love suffer."]
verse_es: Jesús le dijo: “Si puedes creer, todo es posible para el que cree”. Inmediatamente el padre del niño gritó con lágrimas: “¡Creo! Ayuda a mi incredulidad”.

verse: Then he withdrew about a stone’s throw, and knelt down and began to pray. “Father,” he said, “if it is your pleasure, spare me this cup; only, not my will but yours be done.” Presently there appeared to him an angel from heaven, who strengthened him. And, as his anguish became intense, he prayed still more earnestly, while his sweat was like great drops of blood falling on the ground.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm dreading what's about to happen.", "I feel so anxious about the road ahead.", "I wish there was another way through this."]
verse_es: Y él se apartó de ellos a distancia como de un tiro de piedra, y puesto de rodillas oró, diciendo: “Padre, si quieres, aparta de mí esta copa; pero no se haga mi voluntad, sino la tuya”. Y se le apareció un ángel del cielo para fortalecerle. Y estando en agonía, oraba más intensamente; y era su sudor como grandes gotas de sangre que caían hasta la tierra.

verse: Miserable man that I am! Who will deliver me from the body that is bringing me to this death? Thank God, there is deliverance through Jesus Christ, our Lord!
example_user_phrasings: ["I keep doing the things I hate.", "I feel trapped by my own bad habits.", "I don't know how to break free from this cycle."]
verse_es: ¡Qué miserable soy! ¿Quién me librará del cuerpo de esta muerte? ¡Doy gracias a Dios por Jesucristo, nuestro Señor! Así que con la mente, yo mismo sirvo a la ley de Dios, pero con la carne, a la ley del pecado.

verse: We want you, friends, to know that, in the troubles which befell us in Roman Asia, we were burdened altogether beyond our strength, so much so that we even despaired of life. Indeed, we had the presentiment that we must die, so that we might rely, not on ourselves, but on God who raises the dead.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel so overwhelmed I don't know how I'll keep going.", "I'm completely burned out and don't have anything left.", "I'm relying on God because I can't do this on my own."]
verse_es: Hermanos, no queremos que ignoren las aflicciones que sufrimos en la provincia de Asia. Estábamos tan agobiados bajo tanta presión, mucho más allá de nuestras fuerzas, que hasta perdimos la esperanza de salir con vida. De hecho, sentíamos que teníamos la sentencia de muerte encima, para que aprendiéramos a no confiar en nosotros mismos, sino en Dios, que resucita a los muertos.

verse: He will wipe away all tears from their eyes. There will be no more death, nor will there be any more grief or crying or pain. The old order has passed away.
example_user_phrasings: ["I long for a day when there's no more pain.", "I hope this suffering won't last forever.", "I lost someone and I long for eternal comfort."]
verse_es: Enjugará toda lágrima de sus ojos. La muerte ya no existirá, ni habrá más luto, ni llanto, ni dolor. Las primeras cosas han pasado.

verse: Be angry, yet do not sin. Do not let the sun go down on your anger; and give no opportunity to the devil.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm so angry right now I don't know what to do with it.", "I keep holding onto this anger.", "I don't want my anger to control me."]
verse_es: “Si se enojan, no pequen”. No dejen que el sol se ponga estando aún enojados, ni le den cabida al diablo.

verse: Let all bitterness, passion, anger, brawling, and abusive language be banished from among you, as well as all malice. Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, ready to forgive one another, just as God, in Christ, forgave you.
example_user_phrasings: ["I can't seem to let go of this bitterness.", "I'm still holding a grudge against them.", "I don't know how to forgive after what they did."]
verse_es: Alejen de ustedes toda amargura, pasión, enojo, gritos, insultos y toda clase de maldad. Más bien, sean bondadosos y compasivos unos con otros, y perdónense mutuamente, así como Dios los perdonó a ustedes en Cristo.

verse: Love is long-suffering, and kind; love is never envious, never boastful, never conceited, never behaves unbecomingly; love is never self-seeking, never provoked, never reckons up her wrongs; love never rejoices at evil, but rejoices in the triumph of truth; love bears with all things, ever trustful, ever hopeful, ever patient.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel resentful of what others have.", "I wish I could love without keeping score.", "I struggle not to compare myself to others."]
verse_es: El amor es paciente y bondadoso. El amor no tiene envidia. El amor no se jacta, no es orgulloso, no se comporta de forma inadecuada, no busca su propio camino, no se provoca, no tiene en cuenta el mal; no se alegra de la injusticia, sino que se alegra con la verdad; lo soporta todo, lo cree todo, lo espera todo y lo soporta todo.

verse: For father and mother have left me; but the Lord will take me up.
example_user_phrasings: ["My family doesn't want anything to do with me.", "I feel abandoned by the people who should love me.", "I don't feel like I belong anywhere."]
verse_es: Aunque mi padre y mi madre me abandonen, Yahvé me acogerá.

verse: When I think of God, I moan; when I muse, my spirit is faint. When you hold my eyes awake, and I am restless and speechless.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't feel anything anymore.", "I can't sleep and my mind just won't stop.", "I feel like I'm just going through the motions."]
verse_es: Me acuerdo de Dios, y gimo. Me quejo, y mi espíritu se desmaya. Selah. No me dejas cerrar los ojos. Estoy tan angustiado que no puedo ni hablar.

verse: Are not two sparrows sold for a one copper coin? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground without your Father’s knowledge. While as for you, even the hairs of your head are numbered. Do not, therefore, be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm so scared something bad will happen to my kids.", "I can't stop worrying about my family's safety.", "I feel afraid for the people I love."]
verse_es: ¿No se venden dos pajaritos por una moneda de muy poco valor? Sin embargo, ni uno solo de ellos cae al suelo si no es por la voluntad de su Padre. En cuanto a ustedes, hasta los cabellos de su cabeza están todos contados. Así que, no tengan miedo. Ustedes valen más que muchos pajaritos.

verse: God opposes the haughty, but gives grace to the humble. Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will exalt you.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't like admitting when I'm wrong.", "I feel like I have to prove myself to everyone.", "I struggle to ask for help."]
verse_es: Pero él nos da mayor gracia. Por eso dice: “Dios se opone a los orgullosos, pero da gracia a los humildes”. Humíllense ante el Señor, y él los exaltará.

verse: For I, however I am placed, have learned to be independent of circumstances. I know how to face humble circumstances, and I know how to face prosperity. Into all and every human experience I have been initiated – into plenty and hunger, into prosperity and want. I can do everything through the strength of the one who makes me strong!
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm trying to be at peace no matter what my circumstances look like.", "I don't have much right now, but I want to feel okay with that.", "I want to stop comparing my situation to what I used to have."]
verse_es: No digo esto porque esté necesitado, pues he aprendido a estar satisfecho en cualquier situación en que me encuentre. Sé lo que es vivir en la pobreza, y sé lo que es vivir en la abundancia. He aprendido el secreto de ser feliz en cualquier situación, ya sea que esté bien alimentado o que tenga hambre, ya sea que tenga abundancia o que pase necesidad. Todo lo puedo en Cristo que me fortalece.

verse: Trust in the Lord, and do good; remain in the land, and deal faithfully: then the Lord will be your delight, he will grant you your heart’s petitions.
example_user_phrasings: ["I want to find joy in my faith again.", "I'm trying to trust that things will work out.", "I long to feel that closeness with God again."]
verse_es: Confía en Yahvé y haz el bien; habita en la tierra y disfruta de pastos seguros. Deléitate en Yahvé, y él te concederá los deseos de tu corazón.

verse: When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set there, what are mortals, that you think of them, humans, that you visit them?
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel so small compared to everything around me.", "I'm in awe of how amazing creation is.", "It amazes me that God cares about someone like me."]
verse_es: Cuando contemplo tus cielos, obra de tus dedos, la luna y las estrellas que tú has creado, me pregunto: ¿Qué es el hombre, para que te acuerdes de él? ¿Qué es el hijo del hombre, para que lo cuides?

verse: Many misfortunes befall the righteous, but the Lord delivers them out of them all. He guards all their bones, none are broken.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm scared after what happened to me.", "I'm recovering from an injury and don't know what's next.", "I'm grateful I wasn't hurt worse."]
verse_es: Muchas son las aflicciones de los justos, pero de todas ellas los libra Yahvé. Él protege todos sus huesos; ni uno solo de ellos será quebrado.

verse: And he got up and went to his father. But, while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was deeply moved; he ran and threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. ‘Father,’ the son said, ‘I sinned against heaven and against you; I am no longer fit to be called your son.’ But the father turned to his servants and said, ‘Be quick and fetch a robe – the very best – and put it on him; give him a ring for his finger and sandals for his feet; and bring the fattened calf and kill it, and let us eat and make merry; for here is my son who was dead, and is alive again, was lost, and is found.’
example_user_phrasings: ["I've been away from my faith for a long time and don't know how to come back.", "I feel ashamed about how far I've drifted.", "I want to return but I'm afraid I won't be welcomed."]
verse_es: Y levantándose, vino a su padre. Y cuando aún estaba lejos, lo vio su padre, y fue movido a misericordia, y corrió, y se echó sobre su cuello, y le besó. Y el hijo le dijo: ‘Padre, he pecado contra el cielo y contra ti, y ya no soy digno de ser llamado tu hijo’. Pero el padre dijo a sus siervos: ‘Saquen el mejor vestido, y vístanlo; y pónganle un anillo en su mano, y calzado en sus pies. Y traigan el becerro engordado y mátenlo, y comamos y hagamos fiesta; porque este mi hijo muerto era, y ha revivido; se había perdido, y es hallado’. Y comenzaron a regocijarse.

verse: The Lord is my light and my savior; whom then should I fear? The Lord protects my life; whom then should I dread? When the wicked drew near to assail me and eat up my flesh, it was those who distressed and opposed me who stumbled and fell. Though against me a host should encamp, yet my heart would be fearless: though battle should rise up against me, still would I be trustful.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like everyone is against me right now.", "I'm scared of what people might do to me.", "I need courage to face the people who are against me."]
verse_es: Yahvé es mi luz y mi salvación; ¿a quién le temeré? Yahvé es la fortaleza de mi vida; ¿de quién habré de asustarme? Cuando los malvados avanzaron contra mí para devorar mi carne, fueron mis enemigos y adversarios los que tropezaron y cayeron. Aunque un ejército acampe contra mí, mi corazón no temerá; aunque estalle una guerra contra mí, aun así estaré confiado.

verse: Never avenge yourselves, dear friends, but make way for the wrath of God; for scripture declares – “It is for me to avenge, I will requite,” says the Lord. Rather – “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him to drink.” Never be conquered by evil, but conquer evil with good.
example_user_phrasings: ["I want revenge on someone who hurt me.", "I can't stop thinking about getting back at them.", "The rage inside me feels uncontrollable."]
verse_es: No busquen la venganza ustedes mismos, amados, sino den lugar a la ira de Dios. Porque está escrito: “La venganza me pertenece; yo pagaré, dice el Señor”. Por eso “Si tu enemigo tiene hambre, aliméntalo. Si tiene sed, dale de beber; porque al hacerlo, amontonarás carbones de fuego sobre su cabeza”. No te dejes vencer por el mal, sino vence el mal con el bien.

verse: In silence and patience wait on the Lord. Desist from anger, abandon wrath: it leads but to evil. For evildoers will be cut off, but the land will be theirs, who wait on the Lord.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm so consumed with anger I can't think straight.", "I feel like I need to make things right myself.", "I can't let go of my rage toward them."]
verse_es: Quédate quieto ante Yahvé y espéralo con paciencia. No te irrites por el que prospera en su camino, por el hombre que lleva a cabo sus malas intrigas. Deja el enojo y abandona la ira; no te irrites, pues eso solo conduce a hacer el mal. Porque los malvados serán destruidos, pero los que esperan en Yahvé heredarán la tierra.

verse: The Lord is good to those who hope in him, a place of refuge in the day of trouble.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't know where to turn with all this anger inside me.", "I feel like everything is against me right now.", "I need a place of refuge from all this turmoil."]
verse_es: Yahvé es bueno; es un refugio en el día de la angustia, y cuida de los que confían en él.

verse: The helper – the Holy Spirit whom the Father will send in my name – will teach you all things, and will recall to your minds all that I have said to you.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't understand what's happening in my life right now.", "I feel so lost and confused.", "I wish I had more clarity about my next steps."]
verse_es: Pero el Consejero, el Espíritu Santo, que el Padre enviará en mi nombre, les enseñará todas las cosas y les recordará todo lo que les he dicho.

verse: If any one of you lacks wisdom, they should ask wisdom from the God who gives freely to everyone without reproach, and it will be given to them.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't know what decision to make.", "I need wisdom for a hard choice.", "I feel stuck not knowing what to do."]
verse_es: Pero si a alguno de ustedes le falta sabiduría, pídala a Dios, quien da a todos con generosidad y sin reproche, y le será concedida.

verse: See what great love the Father has lavished on us: he lets us be called God’s children! For that is what we are. Dear friends, we are God’s children now, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. What we do know is that, when it is revealed, we will be like him, because we will see him as he is.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't feel like I matter to anyone.", "I struggle to believe I'm worthy of love.", "I feel like I don't belong anywhere."]
verse_es: ¡Miren qué gran amor nos ha dado el Padre, para que seamos llamados hijos de Dios! Por eso el mundo no nos conoce, porque no lo conoció a él. Amados, ahora somos hijos de Dios. Todavía no se ha revelado lo que seremos; pero sabemos que, cuando se revele, seremos como él, porque lo veremos tal como es.

verse: If we confess our sins, he is just and may be trusted to forgive our sins and cleanse us from all wrongdoing.
example_user_phrasings: ["I did something I deeply regret.", "I feel so guilty about what I did.", "I don't know how to forgive myself."]
verse_es: Si confesamos nuestros pecados, él es fiel y justo para perdonarnos los pecados y limpiarnos de toda maldad.

verse: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
example_user_phrasings: ["My heart feels completely broken.", "I don't think I'll ever heal from this.", "I'm devastated after losing someone I love."]
verse_es: Él sana a los que tienen el corazón roto y les venda las heridas.

verse: The Spirit which God gave us was not a spirit of cowardice, but a spirit of power, love, and self-control.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm terrified about what's coming.", "I feel powerless and afraid.", "I don't have the courage to face this."]
verse_es: Porque Dios no nos ha dado un espíritu de cobardía, sino de poder, de amor y de dominio propio.

verse: Though hard pressed on every side, we are never hemmed in; though perplexed, never driven to despair; though pursued, never abandoned; though struck down, never killed!
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like everything is crashing down on me.", "I'm barely holding it together.", "I don't know how much more I can take."]
verse_es: Nos vemos oprimidos por todos lados, pero no aplastados; perplejos, pero no desesperados; perseguidos, pero no abandonados; derribados, pero no destruidos.

verse: The Lord had dealt greatly with us, and we were rejoicing.
example_user_phrasings: ["I can't believe how far I've come.", "I'm so thankful for everything God has done for me.", "I finally feel proud of what I've accomplished."]
verse_es: ¡Yahvé ha hecho grandes cosas por nosotros, y estamos llenos de alegría!

verse: For you did put me together; in my mother’s womb you did weave me. I give you praise for my fashioning so full of awe, so wonderful. Your works are wonderful.
example_user_phrasings: ["I struggle to see my own worth.", "I don't feel like I matter.", "I wonder if I'm truly valued."]
verse_es: Porque tú formaste lo más profundo de mi ser; me entretejiste en el vientre de mi madre. Te doy gracias, porque fui creado de manera maravillosa y sorprendente. Tus obras son maravillosas, y mi alma lo sabe muy bien.

verse: Let the peace that the Christ gives decide all doubts within your hearts; for you also were called to the enjoyment of peace as members of one body. And show yourselves thankful.
example_user_phrasings: ["I can't decide what to do and it's stressing me out.", "I need peace of mind about this situation.", "I keep going back and forth in my head."]
verse_es: Y que la paz de Dios gobierne en sus corazones, a la que también fueron llamados en un solo cuerpo; y sean agradecidos.

verse: Be firm and brave, never be daunted or dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm scared about this new chapter of my life.", "I need courage to take the next step.", "I don't feel ready for what's ahead."]
verse_es: ¿No te lo he ordenado yo? Esfuérzate y sé valiente; no temas ni te acobardes, porque Yahvé, tu Dios, estará contigo adondequiera que vayas.

verse: May God, who inspires our hope, grant you perfect happiness and peace in your faith, until you are filled with this hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm trying to hold onto hope in a hard season.", "I want to feel joyful again.", "I need peace as I keep believing."]
verse_es: Que el Dios de la esperanza los llene de toda alegría y paz en la fe, para que abunden en la esperanza con la fuerza del Espíritu Santo.

verse: He gives the childless woman a home, and makes her the happy mother of children.
example_user_phrasings: ["I've been struggling to have a child and I don't know if it will ever happen.", "I feel like something is missing without children.", "I'm holding onto hope that I'll become a parent someday."]
verse_es: Él le da un hogar a la mujer estéril, y la hace una madre feliz con sus hijos. ¡Alabado sea Yah!

verse: Children are a gift of the Lord, the fruit of the womb, a reward.
example_user_phrasings: ["I just had a baby and I'm overwhelmed with gratitude.", "I want to remember how precious this new life is.", "I'm so thankful for my child."]
verse_es: Miren, los hijos son una herencia de Yahvé, el fruto del vientre es una verdadera recompensa.

verse: Father of orphans, defender of widows, is God in his holy abode. God brings home the lonely, he leads forth the prisoner to comfort, so that none but the rebel lives cheerless.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel so alone, like nobody is looking out for me.", "I wish I had a family or community to belong to.", "I have a loved one in prison and I don't know how to cope."]
verse_es: Padre de los huérfanos y defensor de las viudas, es Dios en su santa morada. Dios da una familia a los solitarios. Saca a los prisioneros a la libertad con cantos, pero los rebeldes se quedan a vivir en un desierto abrazador.

verse: Then the Lord God said, “It is not good for the human to be alone; I will make a helper suited to him.” ... For this reason a man leaves his father and his mother and clings to his wife, and the two become one flesh.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm getting married soon and want God's blessing on our union.", "I'm nervous about starting this new chapter with my spouse.", "I want our marriage to be built on something lasting."]
verse_es: Luego Yahvé Dios dijo: “No es bueno que el hombre esté solo. Voy a hacerle una ayuda adecuada”. Por eso el hombre deja a su padre y a su madre, y se une a su mujer, y los dos se funden en un solo ser.

verse: The righteous will sprout like the palm, will grow like a cedar of Lebanon. In the house of the Lord are they planted, in the courts of our God they will sprout. They will still bear fruit in old age, all sappy and fresh will they be.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm retiring soon and wondering what's next for me.", "I feel like I still have purpose even as I get older.", "I'm afraid getting older means I have less to offer."]
verse_es: El justo florecerá como la palmera; crecerá fuerte como un cedro del Líbano. Están plantados en la casa de Yahvé; florecerán en los atrios de nuestro Dios. Incluso en su vejez seguirán dando frutos; estarán llenos de vitalidad y siempre verdes,

verse: I will not leave you bereaved; I will come to you.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel so alone since losing someone I love.", "I'm scared of feeling abandoned.", "I need to know I'm not alone in this."]
verse_es: No los dejaré huérfanos. Vendré a ustedes.

verse: Of this I am confident, that he who began a good work in you will complete it in readiness for the day of Jesus Christ.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm finishing this chapter of my life and wondering what's next.", "I hope all this hard work has been worth it.", "I'm nervous about starting something new after this milestone."]
verse_es: Estoy convencido de esto: el que comenzó tan buena obra en ustedes la irá perfeccionando hasta el día de Cristo Jesús.

verse: Look at the wild birds – they neither sow, nor reap, nor gather into barns; and yet your heavenly Father feeds them! Aren’t you more precious than they?
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm worried about how I'll make ends meet.", "I don't know how I'm going to pay for everything I need.", "I'm anxious about providing for my family."]
verse_es: Fíjense en las aves del cielo: no siembran, ni cosechan, ni guardan en graneros, y sin embargo, su Padre celestial las alimenta. ¿Acaso no valen ustedes mucho más que ellas?

verse: Cast me not off in the time of old age; when my strength is spent, forsake me not.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm afraid of being forgotten as I get older.", "I worry no one will be there for me when I'm old.", "I feel like I'm losing my strength and independence."]
verse_es: No me rechaces ahora que soy viejo. No me abandones cuando me fallen las fuerzas.

verse: You should all be united, sympathetic, full of love for each other, kind-hearted, humble-minded; never returning evil for evil, or abuse for abuse, but, on the contrary, blessing. It was to this that you were called – to obtain a blessing!
example_user_phrasings: ["My spouse and I keep hurting each other.", "I don't know how to stop fighting with the people I love.", "I want to respond with love instead of anger in my marriage."]
verse_es: En fin, vivan todos en armonía, unidos en un mismo sentir y amándose como hermanos. Sean compasivos y humildes. No devuelvan mal por mal, ni insulto por insulto; al contrario, bendigan, porque a esto fueron llamados, para que hereden una bendición.

verse: My God, out of the greatness of his wealth, will, in glory, fully satisfy your every need, through your union with Christ Jesus.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm struggling to pay my bills.", "I don't know how we'll make it through this financial hardship.", "I'm anxious about finding a new job."]
verse_es: Y mi Dios proveerá a todas sus necesidades, conforme a sus gloriosas riquezas en Cristo Jesús.

verse: Be content with what you have, for God himself has said – ‘I will never forsake you, nor will I ever abandon you.’ Therefore we may say with confidence – ‘The Lord is my helper, I will not be afraid. What can mere people do to me?’
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm scared about money.", "I don't know how I'll get through this alone.", "I need to trust that I won't be abandoned."]
verse_es: Sean sus costumbres sin amor al dinero, contentos con lo que tienen ahora; porque él dijo: “No te desampararé, ni te abandonaré”; de manera que podemos decir con confianza: “El Señor es mi ayudador; no temeré Lo que me pueda hacer el hombre”.

verse: “Repent,” answered Peter, “and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins; and then you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit. For the promise is for you and for your children, and also for all those now far away, who may be called by the Lord our God.”
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm just starting to explore what it means to have faith.", "I want to begin a relationship with God but don't know where to start.", "I'm considering getting baptized."]
verse_es: Pedro les contestó: “Arrepiéntanse y bautícense cada uno de ustedes en el nombre de Jesucristo para el perdón de sus pecados, y recibirán el don del Espíritu Santo. Porque la promesa es para ustedes, para sus hijos y para todos los que están lejos; para todos aquellos a quienes el Señor nuestro Dios llame.”

verse: See, I am with you, and will keep you wherever you go and will bring you again to this land; for I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm moving somewhere new and scared about starting over.", "I don't know anyone in this new place.", "I'm anxious about leaving everything familiar behind."]
verse_es: Yo estoy contigo; te protegeré por dondequiera que vayas y te traeré de vuelta a esta tierra. No te abandonaré hasta cumplir con todo lo que te he prometido.

verse: Blessed is the God and Father of Jesus Christ our Lord, the all-merciful Father, the God ever ready to console, who consoles us in all our troubles, so that we may be able to console those who are in any trouble with the consolation that we ourselves receive from him.
example_user_phrasings: ["I've been struggling with my mental health for a long time.", "I feel like I need comfort that lasts, not just quick fixes.", "I'm tired of carrying this weight day after day."]
verse_es: Bendito sea el Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, Padre misericordioso y Dios de todo consuelo, quien nos consuela en todas nuestras tribulaciones para que, con el mismo consuelo que de Dios hemos recibido, también nosotros podamos consolar a todos los que sufren.

verse: You have turned my mourning to dancing; my sackcloth you have unloosed, and clothed me with joy: that unceasingly I should sing your praise, and give thanks to you, Lord my God, forever.
example_user_phrasings: ["I've been in mourning for so long, I don't know if joy will ever return.", "I want to trust that this sadness won't last forever.", "I long to feel joy again after all this loss."]
verse_es: Tú cambiaste mi luto en danza; me quitaste la ropa de luto y me vestiste de alegría, para que mi corazón te cante alabanzas y no se quede callado. ¡Yahvé, mi Dios, te daré gracias por siempre!

verse: Firm is the faith I cherish, that I, in the land of the living, will yet see the goodness of God. Let your heart be courageous and strong, and wait on the Lord.
example_user_phrasings: ["I need courage to keep waiting for things to get better.", "I'm trying to trust I'll see good come from this.", "I feel discouraged and need strength to hold on."]
verse_es: Pero yo estoy seguro de esto: que veré la bondad de Yahvé en la tierra de los vivientes. Espera en Yahvé. Sé fuerte, y que tu corazón se llene de valor. Sí, espera en Yahvé.

verse: Bear one another’s burdens, and so carry out the Law of the Christ.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like I'm carrying this alone.", "I'm exhausted from taking care of everything by myself.", "I wish someone would help share this burden."]
verse_es: Ayúdense mutuamente a llevar sus cargas, y así cumplirán la ley de Cristo.

verse: Jesus, however, said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for it is to the childlike that the kingdom of heaven belongs.” So he placed his hands on them, and then went on his way.
example_user_phrasings: ["I worry I'm not doing right by my kids.", "I want my children to know they're loved and valued.", "I feel overwhelmed trying to raise my children well."]
verse_es: Jesús les dijo: “Dejen a los niños y no les impidan que se acerquen a mí, porque el Reino de los Cielos es de los que son como ellos”. Después de poner las manos sobre ellos, se fue de allí.

verse: Since it is by God’s mercy that we are engaged in this ministry, we do not lose heart. Even though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day. The light burden of our momentary trouble is preparing for us a weight of imperishable glory, beyond all measure. We, all the while, gaze not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is transient, but what is unseen is imperishable.
example_user_phrasings: ["My body is failing but I'm trying to hold onto hope.", "I'm exhausted from this long illness.", "I need to believe there's more beyond this suffering."]
verse_es: Por lo tanto, no nos desanimamos. Aunque nuestro cuerpo físico se va desgastando, nuestro ser interior se renueva día a día. Pues nuestros pequeños y pasajeros sufrimientos producen en nosotros una gloria eterna que pesa muchísimo más que todos ellos. Así que no nos fijamos en lo visible, sino en lo invisible, ya que lo que se ve es pasajero, mientras que lo que no se ve es eterno.

verse: No temptation has come upon you that is not common to all humanity. God will not fail you, and he will not allow you to be tempted beyond your strength; but, when he sends the temptation, he will also provide the way of escape, so that you may have strength to endure.
example_user_phrasings: ["I keep falling back into the same struggle.", "I don't know if I have the strength to resist this temptation.", "I need to believe there's a way out of this cycle."]
verse_es: Ninguna tentación les ha sobrevenido sino la que es común al hombre. Fiel es Dios, que no permitirá que sean tentados por encima de sus posibilidades, sino que junto con la tentación les dará la vía de escape, para que puedan soportarla.

verse: “Master,” they cried, “save us; we are lost!” “Why are you so timid?” he said. “You of little faith!” Then Jesus rose and rebuked the winds and the sea, and a great calm followed.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like I'm in the middle of a storm I can't control.", "Everything feels like it's falling apart around me.", "I'm terrified and don't know if things will be okay."]
verse_es: Los discípulos se acercaron, lo despertaron y le gritaron: “¡Señor, sálvanos, que nos estamos hundiendo!”. Él les contestó: “¿Por qué tienen tanto miedo, hombres de poca fe?”. Entonces se levantó y reprendió a los vientos y a las olas, y todo quedó completamente tranquilo.

verse: “Blessed are you when people insult you, and persecute you, and say all kinds of evil lies about you because of me. Be glad and rejoice, because your reward in heaven will be great; this is the way they persecuted the prophets who lived before you.”
example_user_phrasings: ["People are treating me unfairly because of my faith.", "I feel targeted for what I believe.", "I don't understand why people are so cruel to me."]
verse_es: Benditos son ustedes cuando los insulten, los persigan y digan toda clase de mal contra ustedes falsamente, por mi causa. Alégrense y regocíjense, porque su recompensa es grande en el cielo. Porque así persiguieron a los profetas que vivieron antes que ustedes.

verse: You will show me the path that leads to life, to that fulness of joy which is in your presence, and the pleasures dispensed by your hand evermore.
example_user_phrasings: ["I want to feel that closeness with God again.", "I'm searching for real joy in my life.", "I long for lasting happiness, not just fleeting moments."]
verse_es: Me mostrarás el camino de la vida. En tu presencia hay alegría total. En tu mano derecha hay placeres para siempre.

verse: O my soul, bless the Lord; and forget not one of his benefits. He pardons all your sins, he heals all your diseases. He ransoms your life from the pit, he crowns you with kindness and pity. He gives you your heart’s desire, renewing your youth like the eagle’s.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel weighed down by my past mistakes.", "I'm dealing with an illness and need hope for healing.", "I want to feel renewed instead of stuck in shame."]
verse_es: Alaba a Yahvé, alma mía, y no olvides ninguno de sus beneficios. Él perdona todos tus pecados, y sana todas tus enfermedades; él rescata tu vida de la tumba, y te corona de amor y compasión; él satisface tus deseos con cosas buenas, para que te renueves como el águila.

verse: I sought the Lord, and, in answer, he saved me from all my terrors.
example_user_phrasings: ["I've been living in constant fear.", "I need relief from all this anxiety.", "I'm scared and don't know where else to turn."]
verse_es: Busqué a Yahvé, y él me respondió; me libró de todos mis temores.

verse: There is no fear in love; perfect love drives out fear because fear has to do with punishment. So anyone who is afraid has not reached perfection in love.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm afraid I'm not good enough to be loved.", "Fear keeps holding me back from trusting others.", "I want to feel secure instead of anxious about being judged."]
verse_es: En el amor no hay temor, sino que el amor perfecto echa fuera el temor, porque el temor tiene castigo. El que teme no se ha perfeccionado en el amor.

verse: I lift up my eyes to the mountains. From where will help for me come? My help will come from the Lord, the creator of heaven and earth. Your foot he will not let stumble: he who guards you will not sleep. The Lord will guard your going and coming from now and for evermore.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm moving to a new place and feeling anxious about it.", "I don't know what to expect in this next chapter.", "I need reassurance that I'll be looked after wherever I go."]
verse_es: Levanto mis ojos a las montañas; ¿de dónde vendrá mi ayuda? Mi ayuda viene de Yahvé, el creador del cielo y de la tierra. Él no permitirá que tu pie resbale; tu protector jamás se dormirá. Yahvé cuidará tus salidas y tus entradas, desde ahora y para siempre.

verse: Though the fig tree bears no fruit, and there are no grapes on the vines, though the olive harvest fails, and the fields produce no food, though the flock is cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will exult in the Lord, and rejoice in the God who saves me. The Lord God is my strength; he makes my feet as sure as the feet of deer, and causes me to walk on the heights!
example_user_phrasings: ["I've lost so much and don't know how we'll get by.", "Even though things look bleak financially, I want to trust God.", "I'm trying to find joy despite having so little right now."]
verse_es: Aunque la higuera no florezca, ni haya uvas en las vides; aunque se pierda la cosecha de aceitunas y los campos no den alimento; aunque no haya ovejas en el redil ni vacas en los establos; aun así, yo me alegraré en Yahvé, y me llenaré de gozo en el Dios de mi salvación. ¡Yahvé el Señor es mi fuerza! Él me da pies ligeros como de venado, y me hace caminar por las alturas.

verse: Come and see what the Lord has done, working appallingly in the earth. He stills wars to the ends of the earth. “Refrain; and know surely that I am God, high over the nations, high over the world.” On our side is the Lord of Hosts, our sure defence is the God of Jacob.
example_user_phrasings: ["Everything around me feels chaotic and out of control.", "I need to find peace amid all this turmoil.", "I want to trust that God is still in control."]
verse_es: Vengan y vean las obras de Yahvé, las cosas asombrosas que ha hecho en la tierra. Él hace cesar las guerras hasta los confines de la tierra; quiebra el arco, destroza la lanza, y quema los carros de guerra en el fuego. “Quédense quietos, y reconozcan que yo soy Dios. Seré exaltado entre las naciones; seré exaltado en la tierra”. Yahvé de los Ejércitos está con nosotros; nuestro refugio es el Dios de Jacob. Selah.

verse: I cried out of my distress, to the Lord and he answered me; out of the midst of Sheol I cried aloud, and you heard my voice. As my life slipped away, I remembered the Lord; and my prayer reached you, in your holy temple.
example_user_phrasings: ["I feel like I'm drowning in my problems.", "I cried out to God when everything felt hopeless.", "I don't know if anyone hears me when I pray."]
verse_es: En mi angustia invoqué a Yahvé, y él me respondió. Desde lo profundo del sepulcro grité, y tú escuchaste mi voz. Cuando me quedaba sin fuerzas, me acordé de Yahvé; mi oración llegó a ti, a tu santo templo.

verse: Who is a God like you, forgiving iniquity and passing by the rebellion of the remnant of your people? He does not retain his anger forever, but is one who delights in mercy. He will tread under foot our iniquity; you will cast into the depths of the sea all our iniquities.
example_user_phrasings: ["I can't forgive myself for what I've done.", "I feel like my mistakes define me.", "I need to believe I can be forgiven."]
verse_es: ¿Qué Dios hay como tú, que perdona la maldad y pasa por alto el pecado del resto de su pueblo? Tú no guardas tu enojo para siempre, porque te deleitas en mostrar amor fiel. Tú volverás a tener compasión de nosotros; pondrás fin a nuestras maldades. ¡Tú arrojarás todos nuestros pecados a lo profundo del mar!

verse: The Lord your God is in your midst, a victorious hero. He will rejoice over you with joy, he will renew his love, he will exult over you with singing.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't feel like anyone delights in me.", "I need to know that I'm loved just as I am.", "I want to feel God's presence and comfort."]
verse_es: Yahvé, tu Dios, está en medio de ti: ¡un poderoso que salvará! Se alegrará por ti con gran gozo, te renovará con su amor, se regocijará sobre ti con cánticos.

verse: May the Lord, from whom all peace comes, himself give you his peace at all times and in all ways.
example_user_phrasings: ["I can't seem to find any peace lately.", "My mind is constantly racing with worry.", "I need calm in the middle of all this chaos."]
verse_es: Y que el mismo Señor de paz les dé siempre paz en toda circunstancia. El Señor sea con todos ustedes.

verse: We don’t want you to be ignorant, friends, about those who have passed to their rest. We don’t want you to grieve like other people who have no hope. For, as we believe that Jesus died and rose again, so also we believe that God will bring, with Jesus, those who through him have passed to their rest.
example_user_phrasings: ["I lost someone I love and I don't know how to grieve with hope.", "I'm struggling with the fact that they're gone.", "I want to believe I'll see them again."]
verse_es: Pero no queremos que ignoren, hermanos, acerca de los que han dormido, para que no se entristezcan como los demás, que no tienen esperanza. Porque si creemos que Jesús murió y resucitó, también Dios traerá consigo a los que durmieron en Jesús.

verse: When the kindness of God our Savior and his love for humanity appeared, he saved us, not as the result of any righteous actions that we had done, but due to his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the power of the Holy Spirit.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't feel like I deserve God's love.", "I keep thinking I have to earn my way to being good enough.", "I feel unworthy of grace."]
verse_es: Pero cuando se manifestó la bondad de Dios nuestro Salvador, y su amor por la humanidad, él nos salvó, no por nuestras propias obras de justicia, sino por su misericordia. Nos salvó mediante el lavamiento de la regeneración y de la renovación por el Espíritu Santo,

verse: His divine power has given us everything that is needful for a life of piety, as we advance in the knowledge of him who called us by a glorious manifestation of his goodness.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't feel equipped to handle what's ahead.", "I worry I don't have what it takes.", "I need to believe I have everything I need to get through this."]
verse_es: Su divino poder nos ha concedido todas las cosas que necesitamos para vivir con devoción a Dios, mediante el conocimiento de aquel que nos llamó por su propia gloria y excelencia.

verse: To him who is able to guard you from falling, and to bring you into his glorious presence, blameless and rejoicing – to the one God, our Savior, be ascribed, through Jesus Christ, our Lord, glory, majesty, power, and dominion, as it was before time began, is now, and will be for all time to come. Amen.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm afraid I'll mess everything up.", "I don't trust myself to stay on the right path.", "I need reassurance that I won't fall apart."]
verse_es: Ahora bien, a aquel que es capaz de evitarles el tropiezo y de presentarlos impecables ante la presencia de su gloria con gran alegría, a Dios nuestro Salvador, que es el único sabio, sea la gloria y la majestad, el dominio y el poder, ahora y siempre. Amén.

verse: But Jesus, overhearing what they were saying, said to the synagogue leader, “Do not be afraid; only have faith.”
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm terrified my loved one won't make it.", "I don't know if I can keep believing things will be okay.", "I'm scared of losing someone to this illness."]
verse_es: Pero Jesús, al oír el mensaje pronunciado, dijo inmediatamente al jefe de la sinagoga: “No tengas miedo, solamente cree”.

verse: Then he led them out, and said, “What must I do to be saved?” “Believe in Jesus, our Lord,” they replied, “and you will be saved, you and your household too.”
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't know what I need to do to be saved.", "I'm just starting to explore faith and feel lost.", "I want my whole family to know God too."]
verse_es: Luego los sacó y les preguntó: “Señores, ¿qué debo hacer para ser salvo?”. Ellos le contestaron: “Cree en el Señor Jesucristo, y serás salvo, tú y toda tu familia”.

verse: No one will be able to hold their own against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will never fail you nor forsake you. Be strong, be brave.
example_user_phrasings: ["I'm about to start something new and I'm scared.", "I need courage to face this next step.", "I don't feel ready for this challenge."]
verse_es: Nadie te podrá hacer frente en todos los días de tu vida. Como estuve con Moisés, estaré contigo; no te dejaré ni te desampararé. Esfuérzate y sé valiente, porque tú repartirás a este pueblo como herencia la tierra que juré a sus antepasados que les daría.

verse: Joseph said to them, “Do not be afraid; for am I in the place of God? You plotted mischief against me, but God intended it for good, in order to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of the lives of many people. Now therefore do not be afraid; I will provide for you and your little ones.” He said this kindly, comforting them.
example_user_phrasings: ["Someone I trusted hurt me deeply and I don't know how to forgive them.", "I've been holding onto resentment for what they did to me.", "I want to let go of the pain from being betrayed."]
verse_es: Pero José les respondió: “No tengan miedo. ¿Acaso estoy yo en el lugar de Dios? Es verdad que ustedes pensaron hacerme mal, pero Dios lo cambió en bien para que se cumpliera lo que hoy estamos viendo: salvar la vida de mucha gente. Así que no tengan miedo. Yo los sustentaré a ustedes y a sus hijos”.

verse: Blessed is the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has, in his great mercy, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, given us the new life of undying hope, that promises an inheritance, imperishable, stainless, unfading, which has been reserved for you in heaven – for you who, through faith, are being guarded by the power of God, awaiting a salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last days.
example_user_phrasings: ["I need something to hold onto that won't fade away.", "I'm searching for hope that lasts beyond this life.", "I want to trust there's something greater waiting for me."]
verse_es: Bendito sea el Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo, que según su gran misericordia nos hizo nacer de nuevo a una esperanza viva por la resurrección de Jesucristo de entre los muertos, a una herencia incorruptible, incontaminada y que no se marchita, reservada en el Cielo para ustedes, que por el poder de Dios son guardados por la fe para una salvación que está preparada para ser revelada en el último tiempo.

verse: Always be joyful; never cease to pray; under all circumstances give thanks to God. For this is his will for you as made known in Christ Jesus.
example_user_phrasings: ["I want to find reasons to be thankful even when things are hard.", "I'm trying to stay joyful despite my circumstances.", "I need to remember to give thanks in all things."]
verse_es: Alégrense siempre. Oren sin cesar. Den gracias en todo, porque esta es la voluntad de Dios para con ustedes en Cristo Jesús.

verse: Let us also exult in our troubles; for we know that trouble develops endurance, and endurance strength of character, and strength of character hope, and that hope never disappoints. For the love of God has filled our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given us.
example_user_phrasings: ["I don't know how much more I can endure.", "I'm trying to see the purpose in my suffering.", "I want to believe this hardship will make me stronger."]
verse_es: No sólo esto, sino que también nos alegramos de nuestros sufrimientos, sabiendo que el sufrimiento produce perseverancia; y la perseverancia, carácter probado; y el carácter probado, esperanza; y la esperanza no nos defrauda, porque el amor de Dios ha sido derramado en nuestros corazones por medio del Espíritu Santo que nos fue dado.
